about_snippet.title: Crafted for those who choose differently
about_snippet.text: We believe that sophistication has nothing to do with alcohol. At Waterfords Cocktails, we craft premium ready-to-drink cocktails that deliver the full experience — the taste, the ritual, the moment — completely alcohol-free.

about_page.label: Our Story
about_page.title: We are Waterfords Cocktails
about_page.subtitle: Founded with one clear mission: premium alcohol-free cocktails that never compromise.
about_page.text1: Waterfords Cocktails was founded with one clear mission: to create premium alcohol-free cocktails that do not compromise on taste, elegance, or experience. We believe the future of refined drinking is one where everyone — drivers, parents, athletes, and those who simply choose not to drink — can raise a glass with pride.
about_page.text2: Our Italian Spritz is the result of months of careful formulation. A refined mix of aromatic herbs, fruity citrus, and bittersweet refreshment, bottled in our signature 250ml can. We are based in The Hague and supply retail chains, hospitality venues, wholesalers, and consumers directly across the Netherlands.
about_page.text3: We are proud of what we build, and we are just getting started.
about_page.v1_text: Full cocktail experience. Zero alcohol. We never sacrifice taste.
about_page.v2_text: Open, pour, enjoy. No mixing, no fuss.
about_page.v3_text: Whether you drive, train, or simply prefer to stay sharp — our drinks are for you.
about_page.founder_p1: Behind every can of Waterfords is a team with a genuine passion for premium drinks and a belief that going alcohol-free should never mean going flavour-free.
about_page.founder_p2: We built Waterfords because we saw a gap in the market: ready-to-drink cocktails that look premium, taste premium, and happen to contain zero alcohol. Our Italian Spritz is just the beginning.
about_page.founder_p3: Based in The Hague, we serve retail, hospitality, wholesale, and direct consumers throughout the Netherlands — and we're growing fast.
about_page.cta_strip_text: Discover our Italian Spritz or find where to buy near you.

flavours_page.serve1_text: Raise a glass at weddings, birthdays, or celebrations — without the alcohol.
flavours_page.serve2_text: Unwind after a long day with the refined flavours of Italy in every sip.
flavours_page.serve3_text: Pour over ice into a wine glass and garnish with an orange slice for the full experience.

flavours_page.coming_text: We are continuously developing new expressions. More exciting alcohol-free Spritz varieties are on their way.
flavours_page.cta_text: Find us at retail, hospitality, and online — or order directly.
